about_the_game:
In Aboxcalipse, you step into the shoes of Kaleb, a stock clerk tasked with keeping warehouse operations running even as a zombie apocalypse unfolds around you. This intense 3D top‑down co‑op experience for up to two players challenges you each stage to collect colored materials, combine them correctly into boxes, and load the truck before time runs out—all while clumsy zombies try to sabotage your efforts.

Progress hinges on logistical efficiency and creative box use: assemble the exact number of completed boxes required to meet each level’s objective. As you advance, special box types (explosive, vision‑blocking, giant) unlock, refreshing strategies and amplifying the controlled chaos.

Key Features

  • Local co‑op for up to 2 players (keyboard+mouse & Xbox controller)

  • Fast crafting: slot materials and pills into empty boxes per level recipes

  • Box variety: standard, collectible color boxes, and special effect boxes

  • Tactical challenges: a fixed number of zombies per level, each demanding a unique approach

  • Themed environments: vibrant, obstacle‑filled warehouses

  • Charming visuals: “cute” graphics that blend humor with action

  • Replayability: every stage invites new strategies and teamwork

Get ready for explosive deliveries and an apocalypse that proves logistics can be fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIN7-64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIN7-64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-650 / AMD Ryzen 5600G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1550 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Grab cure materials, build boxes and load them onto the truck while smashing zombies with them along the way. In Aboxcalipse, you and your friend are warehouse workers in a zombie apocalypse who use the stock itself as a weapon to survive
supported_languages: Portuguese - Brazil, English, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
